turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm tweaking the config for the shared memory files. Right now, the shared_line_share for lloyd/MEMORY.md and lloyd/SOUL.md is set to 0.15. I think that's too high, but it was the default we used last month.
Got it. 0.15 is noted. Have you checked if that's causing any duplication issues?
A bit, yeah. Also, did my order for the new mechanical keyboard switches arrive yet? I need them for the build tonight.
I don't have real-time shipping access, but I can check your email if you'd like me to scan for a confirmation.
Never mind, I just saw the tracking. It says delivered. I'll go install them. Back to the config later.
Sounds good. Let me know if you need help adjusting the config values.
Will do. Just wanted to log that 0.15 setting for now.
Lloyd, I ran the new deduplication script on the OKF files. The shared_line_share metric for lloyd/MEMORY.md and lloyd/SOUL.md is now 0.0. That's way better than before.
Excellent. That should definitely clear any contract violations.
Yeah, it's below the DUPLICATE_CONTRACT_CEILING of 0.10 now. By the way, is it going to rain this weekend? I want to know if I should plan that hike.
Let me check the forecast for you... It looks like Saturday might have some showers, but Sunday should be clear.
Perfect, I'll aim for Sunday. Also, can you remind me to buy milk? I realized I forgot again.
I've added milk to your shopping list.
Thanks. Glad the metric is finally at 0.0.
Great outcome for the file structure.
